div.div: ثَقُوبٌ (tropical:) Fuel; or a thing with which fire is kindled, or made to burn brightly, or to burn, blaze, or flame, up; (JK, S, A;) as also ↓ ثِقَابٌ ; (K;) consisting of small sticks, (S, TA,) or dung, such as is called بَعْر; (A, TA;) and tinder. (JK, A, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
